channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Cork-Tipp clash to draw bumper crowd
item.description: A crowd of around 25,000 is expected to descend on SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh for Saturday evening's glamour Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash between Cork and Tipperary.

item.title: 'He needs to be careful'
item.description: Ciarán Whelan has called for patience in Dublin as Ger Brennan strives to strike the right balance between youth and experience.

item.title: UL and Mary I set-up derby Fitzgibbon Cup final
item.description: University of Limerick will face Immaculate College Limerick in Friday week's Fitzgibbon Cup final after both sides came through their respective semi-finals last night.

item.title: "I wasn't useful last year, I wasn't myself physically"
item.description: Armagh captain Aidan Forker says he's not putting a timeframe on his return to duty with the Orchard men.

item.title: Bad weather sees Dublin hurlers' open training session at Marlay Park postponed
item.description: Dublin hurling manager Niall Ó Ceallacháin has confirmed that his squad's open training session at Marlay Park this weekend has been postponed.

item.title: "He transforms this team single-handedly"
item.description: Former Antrim star Neil McManus believes Wexford will need to be patient after a couple of early scares in their Allianz Hurling League Division 1B campaign.

item.title: McGrath: Cork cannot afford to lose to Tipp
item.description: Former Tipperary star Shane McGrath believes Cork cannot afford to lose to Tipp in the teams' crunch Allianz League showdown this weekend.

item.title: 'I've become very aware of the volunteerism and how hard it is'
item.description: Former Dublin captain Denise Masterson is excited to have been afforded the opportunity to be in Croke Park this Saturday as the inaugural Club Summit gets up and running at the Jones' Road venue.

item.title: Cats looking foward to "huge test" against Limerick - Lyng
item.description: Kilkenny manager Derek Lyng says his side are looking forward to "a huge test" against Limerick this weekend in the third round of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: "I was always chasing perfection, and never, ever was going to get it"
item.description: Laura Treacy stands in the middle of Croke Park with a beaming smile.
